newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Police fire on protesters near slain Bhutto's home.
newsitem.headline: Police fire on protesters near slain Bhutto's home.

text.p: Pakistani police fired bullets and teargas at supporters of Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto's dead brother Murtaza during protests near his home in Larkana on Monday, witnesses said.
Two demonstrators were wounded in separate incidents, at least one of them hit by gunfire, the witnesses said.

They said 300 to 400 protesters had gathered in the Lahori Mohallah district of Larkana, close to the home of Murtaza, the focus of mourning since he was killed in a shootout between his bodyguards and police in Karachi on Friday.
The demonstrators were trying to force shopkeepers to pull down their shutters in line with a 10-day strike called by Murtaza's Pakistan People's Party-Shaheed Bhutto faction.
The police used bullets and teargas to disperse them, wounding one demonstrator, witnesses said.
In a separate incident, police shot at a group of demonstrators approaching Murtaza's house, wounding one.
